```{r}


# Install the package if you haven't already
# install.packages("dataRetrieval")

library(dataRetrieval)

# Define your USGS NWIS Site ID (Prepend with "USGS-")
site_id <- "USGS-12082500"

# Fetch monitoring location metadata using the modernized API function
site_metadata <- read_waterdata_monitoring_location(monitoring_location_id = site_id)

# Extract the HUC (Hydrologic Unit Code)
# Note: The field name in the returned dataframe is typically 'huc_cd'
huc_code <- site_metadata$hydrologic_unit_code

huc_lev <- nchar(site_metadata$hydrologic_unit_code)

# Print the result
cat("The HUC for site", site_id, "is:", huc_code, " and the level is: ", huc_lev, "\n")



```
